data: What is the approximate lowest oracle error rate recorded as the lattice density is varied?

The question asks for the approximate lowest oracle error rate recorded as the lattice density is varied. From the left subfigure in Figure 2, we can observe the relationship between oracle error rates and lattice densities for different pruning methods. The red line represents the subsampling+dropout method. 

By examining the red line, we can see that it reaches its lowest point at approximately 1% oracle error rate when the lattice density is around 1000 edges per gold edge. This appears to be the lowest value across all the lines in the graph. Therefore, the approximate lowest oracle error rate recorded as the lattice density is varied is 1%.
